scripts.prebuild-triasm: npx tsx devtools/wasm-instr-gen/res-gen.ts tools/asm/res.ts tools/asm/res/args.txt && npx cre-tool compile -s "tools/**/*.ts"
scripts.postbuild-triasm: node tools/build/postbuild.js starters jsfixup && node bin/js/triasm.js --help-md > doc/triasm/cmd.md
scripts.prebuild-triwasm: npx tsx devtools/wasm-instr-gen/template-gen.ts tools/wasm/skeleton.triasm && npx prettier tools/wasm/skeleton.ts --write --ignore-path .prettierignore && npx tsx devtools/wasm-instr-gen/res-gen.ts tools/wasm/res.ts tools/wasm/res/dump-html.css tools/wasm/res/dump-html.js tools/wasm/res/args.txt
scripts.postbuild-triwasm: node tools/build/postbuild.js starters jsfixup && node bin/js/triwasm.js --help-md > doc/triwasm/cmd.md
scripts.prebuild-runtime: make -C tools/runtime/triwasmlib -j2 get-tools && make -C tools/runtime/softfloatlib -j2 get-tools
scripts.build: concurrently -c white,red,magenta,yellow,blue npm:build-runtime npm:build-triasm npm:build-triwasm npm:build-tricc npm:build-triconf
scripts.rebuild: npm run build-clean && npm run build
